steps: Sign in to SendGrid; this is Settings > API Keys
Enter a name and choose 'Custom Access', then tick Mail Send (or 'Full Access' if you need more)
Click 'Create & View' and copy the key - it is shown exactly once

limited.meaning: the key is valid but is not allowed to list its own permissions; it will still do what you gave it

least_privilege.summary: Custom Access with only Mail Send.

steps: Sign in; this is Settings > API Keys
Open the gear menu next to the leaked key and choose Delete
